summary: Static compatibility boundary for Quasar demo mode. Every demo-critical on-chain path now has a Quasar-native route; MagicBlock PER/TEE is explicitly not claimed by the final Quasar demo path unless separately validated live.

demoCriticalPaths.surface: shared Quasar instruction-data builders for registry/reputation/attestation
demoCriticalPaths.reason: Uses one-byte Quasar discriminators and fixed-size argument layouts from Quasar parity source/tests. Does not claim PER compatibility.

demoCriticalPaths.surface: Quasar transaction-instruction helpers for registry, reputation, and attestation
demoCriticalPaths.reason: Wraps shared Quasar instruction data with account metas/order from Quasar parity source/tests for registry, reputation commit/reveal, and attestation confirm/dispute. Every exported builder here calls assertQuasarProgramTargetUsable() as its first statement, so an instruction is constructed only when the resolved ambient profile is local-surfpool with the Quasar target, four distinct valid local program ids, and loopback-only RPC/WS endpoints; devnet and mainnet are refused before construction.
Selects Quasar registry wrapper when PROGRAM_TARGET is quasar; preserves Anchor builder only for legacy-anchor mode.
Constructs demo-agent register instructions with Quasar register data when PROGRAM_TARGET is quasar and preserves Anchor encoding for legacy mode.

Builds only the legacy Anchor attest_quality layout. It takes no target and no escrow: its single caller refuses the Quasar target before reaching it, because a Quasar attestation seeds its PDA on the escrow a successful lock created and onboarding never locks one.

demoCriticalPaths.surface: shared instruction builders and account decoders
demoCriticalPaths.reason: Exports target-aware Quasar AgentAccount decode/filter constants for read paths; legacy Anchor builders remain available only for legacy-anchor callers while demo-critical Quasar transaction paths route through lib/quasar wrappers.

Registration transaction construction now routes through target-aware `buildAgentRegistrationInstruction`, using Quasar registry wrapper/data in explicit Quasar mode and Anchor data only in legacy mode.

demoCriticalPaths.surface: onboarding registration and attestation confirmation/dispute builders
demoCriticalPaths.reason: Onboarding registration routes through the target-aware registration helper; attestation confirm/dispute delegate to lib/onboarding/attestation-resolution.ts, which refuses the Quasar target and surfaces the canonical reason with both actions disabled, so the page builds no Quasar instruction of its own.

attest_quality refuses the Quasar target outright before any operator key is read, any instruction is built, or any RPC is opened, because onboarding has no verified lock-created escrow to bind an attestation to. Only the legacy Anchor attestation layout is ever constructed here; send remains operator-triggered only.

Commit/reveal reputation refuses the Quasar target outright — onboarding never locks a Quasar escrow, so there is no verified lock record to bind a rating to — and returns the canonical unavailable reason before any operator key is read, any commitment or PDA is derived, any instruction is built, or any RPC is opened. Only the legacy Anchor commit/reveal layout is ever constructed here.

Owns the single canonical reason every onboarding Quasar reputation/attestation/confirm/dispute path refuses with. There is deliberately no resolver or PDA derivation here: onboarding never locks a Quasar escrow, so there is no verified lock record to bind to and no onboarding surface builds a Quasar instruction.

demoCriticalPaths.surface: onboarding consumer confirm/dispute attestation resolution builder
demoCriticalPaths.reason: Single owner of the consumer confirm/dispute path shared by the onboarding page. It refuses the Quasar target outright before any connection is opened, any base58 string is parsed into a PublicKey, any instruction is built, or any signer is used, and constructs only the legacy Anchor confirm/dispute layout.
Uses active target account discriminator/data-size constants and target-aware AgentAccount decode; Quasar mode filters one-byte discriminator 20 and fixed-size Quasar AgentAccount layout.
Uses active target account discriminator/data-size constants and target-aware AgentAccount decode; Quasar mode no longer applies Anchor memcmp/data-size filters.
Demo-agent registration now routes through target-aware helper using Quasar fixed-size one-byte register data in explicit Quasar mode; send remains operator-triggered only.

demoCriticalPaths.surface: full demo-agent A→B→C escrow/reputation/attestation/MagicBlock PER transaction flow
demoCriticalPaths.reason: Full demo-agent A→B→C flow encodes the current Quasar sources in explicit Quasar mode: registry read, Quasar escrow make/take settlement, reputation commit/reveal, and attestation attest. packages/demo-agents/src/config.ts admits that mode only on the local-surfpool profile with four distinct valid loopback-deployed program ids, so the recorded devnet Quasar set is never reached from here. Legacy Anchor/PER paths remain available only in legacy-anchor mode; MagicBlock PER/TEE is fail-closed/not claimed for Quasar.

submissionReadyRule: submissionReady may be true only when every demo-critical on-chain path is Quasar-native and MagicBlock PER/TEE is either live-validated on Quasar or explicitly not part of the final claim.
